# fptcloud_tagging (Resource)


Provides a tagging resource to manage tags for supported FPT Cloud resources. This allows you to create, update, and delete tags, and associate them with resources such as instances, security groups, object storage buckets, and more.


## Example Usage

```terraform
# A tag scoped to a VPC, without a color
resource "fptcloud_tagging" "example" {
  key          = "env"
  value        = "production"
  scope_type   = "VPC"
  resource_ids = ["resource-vpc-id-1", "resource-vpc-id-2"]
}

# A tag scoped to the organization, with a color from the palette
resource "fptcloud_tagging" "example_org" {
  key          = "team"
  value        = "platform"
  color        = "#5850ec" # indigo
  scope_type   = "ORG"
  resource_ids = []
}

# Attach the tags to a subnet and a security group
resource "fptcloud_subnet" "example" {
  vpc_id     = "your_vpc_id"
  name       = "subnet-app"
  type       = "NAT_ROUTED"
  cidr       = "10.10.1.0/24"
  gateway_ip = "10.10.1.1"
  tag_ids    = [fptcloud_tagging.example.id, fptcloud_tagging.example_org.id]
}

resource "fptcloud_security_group" "example" {
  vpc_id    = "your_vpc_id"
  name      = "sg-app"
  subnet_id = fptcloud_subnet.example.id
  type      = "ACL"
  apply_to  = ["10.10.1.0/24"]
  tag_ids   = [fptcloud_tagging.example_org.id]
}
```

## Colors

`color` takes one of the hex values below, the same palette the FPT Cloud portal offers. The value is case-insensitive: `#5850EC` and `#5850ec` are the same color, and the API stores it in lowercase. Leave `color` unset, or set it to `""`, for a tag without a color.

| Color           | Hex       |
|-----------------|-----------|
| Gray            | `#4b5563` |
| Red             | `#c81e1e` |
| Orange          | `#d03801` |
| Yellow          | `#dc6803` |
| Green           | `#057a55` |
| Teal            | `#047481` |
| Indigo          | `#5850ec` |
| Purple          | `#6c2bd9` |
| Sky blue        | `#00bfff` |
| Green (classic) | `#35994b` |
| Amber (classic) | `#e7a600` |
| Red (classic)   | `#db4646` |

Any other value, including a color name such as `red`, is rejected when Terraform plans, before any call to the API.


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.

### Optional

- `value` (String) The value of the tag. This is a free-form string to further describe the tag key (e.g., "production", "dev").
- `color` (String) Hex color of the tag, case-insensitive. One of the twelve colors listed in [Colors](#colors), or empty for no color.
- `scope_type` (String) The scope where the tag applies.(`VPC` , `ORG`).
- `resource_ids` (Set of String) List of resource IDs to which this tag will be attached. The resources must match the selected `scope_type` (e.g., VPC IDs if scope_type is VPC).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the tag.

## Import

Tag resources can be imported using the tag ID:

```shell
terraform import fptcloud_tagging.example <tag_id>
```
